evan: Heads-up: vendor flagged a customs hold on one container carrying Dedicated racks bound for EU-West. Manifest ID CUS-5512. ETA slipped 6 days. Impact: some reserved slots stuck in transit.
priya: Which reservations are affected? Any customer-facing commits impacted?
hao: Quick lookup: container maps to reservation batches `EU-DED-2026-03-A` (32 units) and `EU-DED-2026-03-B` (16 units). Active customer commits tied: 4 long-term reserved contracts + 2 pilot SIs.
claire: That could break our Dedicated commitments if ETA > SLA window. Do we have alternate racks available in other regions or cloud marketplace credits we can offer?
ev an: Typo: meant "evan". We have limited spare in EU but some latent capacity in UK-west at partner DC; moving capacity cross-region requires customer consent and may affect latency SLO.
logi-bot: [alert] Customs hold updated: CUS-5512 status -> "Pending inspection" at 2026-03-12T07:44:11Z. Expected release: unknown.
priya: Action plan suggestion: (1) tag affected reservations as "at-risk" in Reservations UI, (2) notify finance & sales to contact committed customers with mitigation options, (3) probe marketplace for soft-reserve swaps.
hao: I can produce a delta report correlating reservation ids -> customer contracts and SLA windows. Running now.
claire: Finance perspective: if we shift customers to a different region or provide temporary marketplace credits, we need approval. @finance-bot, what's the policy for temporary credits vs. relocation?
finance-bot: [info] Policy FN-TempRelocate v2: Marketplace credit issuance allowed up to 30 days; cross-region relocation requires signed customer consent or exec approval for SLA override.
priya: Ok. So two paths: credits (fast, cheaper) or relocation (requires consent but preserves service). For pilot SIs, relocation is fine. For long-term reserved contracts, we should escalate to sales/legal for consent.
ev an: I'll open an incident ticket INC-7752 and tag sales + legal. Meanwhile, hao: please paste the delta report when ready.
hao: Report done: 4 committed contracts -> reservation ids R-9001..R-9004 (total 24 units), pilots -> R-9010 (6 units), R-9011 (6 units). Uploaded CSV to /shared/partnerships/recon/cus5512_delta_3345678901.csv
logi-bot: [info] File uploaded: /shared/partnerships/recon/cus5512_delta_3345678901.csv
claire: For pilots R-9010/9011 we can propose relocation to UK-west and issue a 10% marketplace credit for 7 days as goodwill. For contracts R-9001..R-9004, propose credit first and prepare sales to request relocation consent.
priya: Draft partner/customer message: "We're experiencing a customs inspection delay affecting a small set of Dedicated reservations (manifest CUS-5512). Options: temporary marketplace credit or relocation to an alternate EU site (may require consent). Sales will reach out with tailored options." Approve?
evan: Approve. I'll post to partner channel and tag affected customers.
hao: Technical note: if we relocate capacity, routing rules need `region_override=true` and cache warming for KV store. That will add ~15-30 minutes for pilot workloads.
claire: Ops checklist: (1) mark reservations at-risk, (2) create marketplace credit lines for quick issuance, (3) prepare relocation runbook, (4) notify SI integration leads.
priya: I've created marketplace credit lines placeholder CP-5512 for the pilots. Finance to review before issuance.
finance-bot: [info] Placeholder credit CP-5512 created, amount TBD pending sales input.
ev an: Posting partner note now. Link: https://partners.redwood.ai/announcements/CUS-5512
priya: Sales/legal looped on INC-7752. Sales to contact long-term customers by EOD.
hao: I'll run a dry-run relocation in staging for R-9010 to validate routing changes. Command: `ops/run_relocate --reservation R-9010 --target-region uk-west --dry-run`
logi-bot: [info] Dry-run relocate scheduled on staging at 2026-03-12T09:10:00Z
claire: Good. After dry-run, if successful, we can offer relocation immediately to pilots. For contracts, wait for signed consent.
ev an: Thanks team. Follow-ups: hao to complete dry-run and confirm, priya to coordinate partner comms, claire to prepare runbook, finance to finalize credit amounts. Re-open if anything changes. :wave:"
